title: Virtua Fighter CG Portrait Series Vol. 6: Lau Chan
native_title: バーチャ・ファイター ＣＧポートレート・シリーズ Ｖｏｌ．６ 「ラウ・チェン」
overview:
Character CG from Virtua Fighter and an image song blend together beautifully...

Volume 6 of the CG Portrait Series is devoted to Lau Chan. Newly made computer graphics show him leaping across mountain cliffs, reading a scroll among the peaks and moving through a moonlit bamboo grove, in a sequence staged to his image song "Kin'iro no Ame", a single from the Virtua Fighter 2 vocal album Dancing Shadows.

Choose "Karaoke" and the lyrics appear on screen so you can sing along.

- Original CG portraits of Lau Chan
- Image song with a karaoke mode

「バーチャファイター」のキャラクターCGとイメージソングが華麗に融合する…
